intro: The words this guide uses for the parts of a page and of a site, one concept to a word. Each is explained where a page first uses it; here they are all together, in groups.

terms.definition: The body a page is drawn in, named in its front matter: docs, the default, or cards.
terms.note: The layout changes only the body; the navbar and the header band are the same on every page.

terms.definition: The strip under the navbar holding a page's pretitle, title and lead.

not.why: a hero is a landing page's banner; the band is on every page

terms.definition: A raised surface holding one part of a page, with an optional header naming it.
terms.example: on a cards page, each ## section is a card, its italic first line the card's subtitle

terms.definition: Whether a page still agrees with the code it describes: built, designed, drifted or disagrees.
terms.form: a red, amber or green dot on the map and in the page's footer

terms.definition: A titled group of pages in the site's nav, drawn as a menu in the navbar and as a card on the map.
terms.note: A section may hold sections of its own; their pages are listed under a header in the menu.

terms.definition: Every section of the site as a card, its pages listed with their descriptions and standings.
terms.form: `map: true` in a page's front matter

terms.definition: The site's words and what they mean, one file the tooltips and the lexicon page both read.
terms.example: this page is the lexicon of this guide, drawn from docs/lexicon.json

terms.definition: One word of the lexicon with its definition, explained in a tooltip where a page first uses it.
A script beside the pages that sets a part of the site's data, which a page names in its front matter.
terms.example: `window.ALMANAC_DATA.showcase = {pages: 4}` fills every place a page names showcase.pages
terms.note: A script rather than JSON, so a site opened from disk reads it with no server.
